title: epicrop
text: {epicrop} provides R package ‘EPIRICE’ model described (Savary et al. 2012), modified EPIRICE model described (Kim et al. 2015), ‘EPIWHEAT’ model described (Savary et al. 2015) generic SEIR model function, seir(), modelling crop disease epidemics. model uses daily weather data estimate disease intensity. function, get_wth(), provided simplify downloading weather data via {nasapower} package (Sparks 2018) predict disease intensity five rice diseases using generic SEIR model (Zadoks 1971) function, seir(). ‘EPIRICE’, default values derived literature suitable modelling unmanaged disease intensity five rice diseases, bacterial blight (bacterial_blight()); brown spot (brown_spot()); leaf blast (leaf_blast()); sheath blight (sheath_blight()) tungro (tungro()) two modified Kim et al. (2015), (modified_kim_leaf_blast() helper_modified_kim_sheath_blight()), provided. modified Kim versions provide leaf blast sheath blight models include additional weather parameters modified equations better reflect disease progress certain environmental conditions Korean Peninsula. ‘EPIWHEAT’ model includes two wheat diseases, leaf rust (leaf_rust()) septoria tritici blotch (s_tritici_blotch()), default values derived literature suitable modelling unmanaged disease intensity diseases. Using package functions designed straightforward modelling rice disease risks, flexible enough accommodate pathosystems using seir() function. interested modelling pathosystems, please refer (2012) development parameters used rice diseases derived existing literature implemented individual disease model functions.

Described Table 1 Savary et al. 2012. H0 initial number plant's healthy sites (integer). Described Table 1 Savary et al. 2012. I0 initial number infective sites (scalar integer). Described Table 1 Savary et al. 2012. I0 injected new infections (become infectious p days). RcA modifier Rc (basic infection rate corrected removals) crop age numeric two-column matrix first column crop age days (0 duration-1) DVS (0 2) second modifier (bounded 0 1). Described Tables 1 2 Savary et al. 2012. RcT modifier Rc (basic infection rate corrected removals) temperature numeric two-column matrix first column temperature degrees C second modifier (bounded 0 1). Described Tables 1 2 Savary et al. 2012. RcOpt potential basic infection rate corrected removals (numeric). Described Table 1 Savary et al. 2012. value can modified reflect crop cultivar resistance ratings well, see Kim _et al. _ 2015 details. p duration latent period (day, integer function temperature). Described Table 1 Savary et al. 2012. duration infectious period (day, integer function temperature). Described Table 1 Savary et al. 2012. Sx maximum number sites (integer). Described Table 1 Savary et al. 2012. aggregation coefficient, values 1 >1 (numeric function DVS). Described Table 1 Savary et al. 2012 Table 1 Savary et al. 2015. See details - Aggregation section. Defaults 1. rhlim relative humidity value threshold decide whether leaves wet (numeric). Described Table 1 Savary et al. 2012. Savary et al. 2012 used 90. Defaults 90. rainlim rainfall amount (mm) threshold decide whether leaves wet (numeric). Described Table 1 Savary et al. 2012. Savary et al. 2012 used 5. Defaults 5. RRS relative rate physiological senescence (numeric, vector, function DVS). Described Table 1 Savary et al. 2012. RRG relative rate growth (numeric, vector, function time). Described Table 1 Savary et al. 2012. RcW Optional modifier Rc calculate leaf wetness effect 1 wet 0 dry.  numeric two-column matrix first column hours (0 24) second modifier (bounded 0 1). Used simple_wetness = FALSE (hourly/derived wetness). NULL (default), linear relationship used 0 hours wet = 0 24 hours wet = 1. Ignored simple_wetness = TRUE. RRLEX Rate lesion expansion (scalar, vector, function). Allows healthy sites directly converted infectious sites without passing latent stage. Set 0 (default) standard SEIR behavior. simple_wetness Logical.  TRUE (default), uses binary wetness calculation (0 1) based rhlim rainlim thresholds.
